name: The Missing Scholar

faq.answer: Fillion Flamebreeze is a scholar who was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when Windshapers ambushed him. Left bleeding and unconscious outside a nearby cave, he was dragged inside by a massive winged predator.

The Overlook Standing Stones were the site of Fillion Flamebreeze’s scholarly assignment. His journey back from the stones led to an ambush by Windshapers. The precise nature of his research is unclear.
faq.q: What was Fillion doing at the Overlook Standing Stones?

faq.answer: Windshapers ambushed and battered Fillion Flamebreeze. They forced him to the mouth of a nearby cave and left him bleeding and barely conscious.
A massive winged beast in a cave north of the ambush site took Fillion from the cave entrance. It dragged him into its lair to feed itself and its hungry younglings.
faq.q: What creature took Fillion into the cave?

faq.answer: Clues at the site of Fillion Flamebreeze’s misfortune point to a cave just to the north. Inside, he is trapped in the beast’s nesting grounds and awaits rescue before he is devoured.
faq.q: Where can Fillion Flamebreeze be found?

faq.answer: Fillion survives his ordeal because someone intervenes in the cave in time. Without an adventurer finding and helping him, he would have become dinner for the winged beast and its offspring.
faq.q: What was the fate of the missing scholar?

sections.body: You find signs of trouble along the trail Fillion Flamebreeze took on his travels. They point to foul play. Following them leads north to a dark cave. The missing scholar may still be alive inside, waiting for help.
sections.title: The Vanished Researcher

sections.body: Fillion Flamebreeze was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when Windshapers ambushed him. They battered him, dragged him to the cave entrance, and left him bleeding. Helpless, he faced whatever waited within.
sections.title: Ambush by the Windshapers

sections.body: As Fillion lay fading at the cavern’s threshold, a massive winged beast emerged from the dark and dragged him inside. It carried him deep into its lair as prey for its younglings. Timely rescue spared him that fate.
sections.title: Lair of the Winged Beast

summary: You follow the trail of Fillion Flamebreeze, missing after an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones. The search leads north to a cave, where he was dragged by a winged beast.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Missing Scholar
